summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands on experience building and debugging distributed embedded systems across STM32, Jetson, and Arduino platforms, including concurrent sensing and control pipelines built on FreeRTOS. Comfortable working across software and hardware boundaries, from bare metal interrupt driven firmware to WebSocket connected distributed control systems, with a track record of root causing integration failures. Experienced with Python tooling, version controlled workflows in GitLab, and validating autonomous system behavior in simulation.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture recognition glove for hands free cursor control, integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with a Raspberry Pi over Bluetooth (HC-05) to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.

Debugged and resolved sensor jitter in a custom tap detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding, iterating on software calibration and resolution tuning across the firmware to application boundary.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Designed a custom wavelet bank to suppress low frequency noise; combined with optimized homography stitching and concurrency to raise output PSNR from 65 to 86.
Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline spanning image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation into a single reliable system.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real time data acquisition, monitoring, and experimental visualization in a laboratory test environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation across a multi person lab team.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a distributed, three layer embedded system (Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, Jetson+Arduino controller) linked by a WebSocket fabric, coordinating concurrent sensing, inference, and actuation.

Debugged and resolved 11 integration failures across the distributed pipeline (false positive detections, servo brown out, stale frame capture) through systematic root cause investigation; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).
Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup) for visual servoing and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact aware grasping via TCA9548A I2C mux.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared memory task coordination across concurrent sensing and control tasks on an STM32 microcontroller.
Implemented multi servo PWM control with interrupt driven UART command handling and user override, communicating with an NVIDIA Jetson running YOLOv8 detection.
Integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization for real time system observability.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated data generation and validation pipelines using CARLA's semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.

Validated an adaptive lane following and waypoint fallback control stack in a simulated Town02 environment with 30 vehicles and 10 pedestrians, achieving zero collisions and correct traffic light compliance across multiple laps.
